description: This file defines the configuration for the Prometheus/STM32F469 board in a firmware project. It includes macro definitions for oscillators, voltages, and detailed GPIO pin configurations, including modes, output types, speeds, pull-up/down resistors, and alternate function mappings. It is part of the hardware abstraction layer, specifying how the microcontroller pins are set up for this specific board.
